preconditions.description: The dimensions n (rows) and m (columns) are integers between 1 and 100 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(matrix) == n and all(len(row) == m for row in matrix)
preconditions.description: The input contains exactly n rows, each with exactly m integers.

preconditions.expression: all(-100 <= x <= 100 for row in matrix for x in row)
preconditions.description: Every integer in the table has an absolute value less than or equal to 100.

postconditions.description: The number of printed row indices matches the count 'a', and the number of printed column indices matches the count 'b'.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= r <= n for r in row_indices) and len(set(row_indices)) == len(row_indices)
postconditions.description: All selected row numbers are within the valid range [1, n] and are distinct.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= c <= m for c in col_indices) and len(set(col_indices)) == len(col_indices)
postconditions.description: All selected column numbers are within the valid range [1, m] and are distinct.

postconditions.expression: all(sum(matrix[i][j] * (-1 if (i+1) in row_indices else 1) * (-1 if (j+1) in col_indices else 1) for j in range(m)) >= 0 for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: After applying the sign changes to the selected rows and columns, the sum of every row in the modified table is non-negative.

postconditions.expression: all(sum(matrix[i][j] * (-1 if (i+1) in row_indices else 1) * (-1 if (j+1) in col_indices else 1) for i in range(n)) >= 0 for j in range(m))
postconditions.description: After applying the sign changes to the selected rows and columns, the sum of every column in the modified table is non-negative.
